explication: Magic Resume is a browser-based resume editor. Users create or import resumes in the dashboard, edit structured content in the workbench, choose a template and theme, preview the result, and export it to PDF; resume data is autosaved locally and can sync with a user-selected directory. AI writing and grammar assistance, model configuration, PDF import, multilingual UI, and template browsing are separate product capabilities. The README documents several of these features; sampled source confirms store behavior, PDF-import requests, and AI endpoints, but does not expose all UI-to-service wiring.
